identification: Oil on canvas (or canvas board), loose palette-knife/brush impressionist study of a nude woman lying prone, propped on her forearm, seen from behind with a white drape over her hips, warm ochre and blue palette. Modern crackle-gilt moulding frame with orange slip. Looks like late-20th/21st-century decorative studio work (the style mass-produced for the furnishing trade), not period. 29 x 39 cm.

entries.note: Vintage sleeping nude oil by R. McQuillan, Melbourne, 1 bid. Signed, so better than this lot.
Small Italian decorative oil, framed, woman figure, BIN.

viewing_check: Check the back for a signature, title, gallery or 'made in China' style stretcher label; check if canvas is on a printed base (some decorative 'oils' are hand-embellished prints).
